objective: A frozen census: the not-all-equal law on every non-surface d-regular world on six distinctions, on a seeded random sample at 13 to 30 distinctions, and on degree-preserving knot swaps of faithful flat tori at 24 to 48, for d = 4 to 7 where each family has worlds, reporting which are read faithfully and the defect each faithful one carries; predictions as registered.
status: Closed: supported 2026-11-11 (frozen, exact): 160 of 822 swap worlds (6-regular, 24 to 48 distinctions, faithful flat tori with 1, 2 or 4 knot swaps) are read faithfully by NAE though none is a surface (pairs in one knot; 22 also pairs in three or more); the smallest, 25 distinctions, checked independently. No faithful world among 1,440 random regular worlds (d = 4 to 7, 13 to 30) or the 21 non-surface worlds on 6 distinctions. P1, P3 hold; P2 fails. Every registered cell ran.
title: Faithful non-surface worlds under not-all-equal
